achievements.name: Complete The Tutorial
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.TutorialCompleted, transition to the unlock task.

achievements.name: Punch Kristopher
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.CharacterDamaged: target matches Id.Character.Kristopher, CauseEntityTag equals Id.Item.Fists, and Instigator equals the context PlayerState.

achievements.name: Top Cash Earner
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: No event transition: Analytics.Player.Cash.Earned placement equals 1 and its value is greater than 0.

achievements.name: Single Life Profit
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.ProfitChanged: the Get Match Stat Difference output for current-life cash earned/spent is compared with CashThreshold using GreaterOrEqual.

achievements.name: Loadout Spender
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.LoadoutPurchased: ActionTag equals Meta.Progression.Resources.MatchScore.Purchased.Loadout, and the cash ResourceChangedAmount output is compared with CashThreshold using GreaterOrEqual. The native sign/consumer behavior is unverified.

achievements.name: Control Zone Survivor
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: The control-zone tag listener leads to a pawn-alive check and a delay bound to RequiredSeconds. Tag removal or respawn returns to waiting; a vitality event targeting the context PlayerState also returns to waiting. Timer-state completion leads to unlock. Effective event filtering/completion behavior is unverified.

achievements.name: Long Shot
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.LongShotVitalityChanged: InstigatorPlayerState equals the context PlayerState, ActionTag equals KillScore, target/instigator hostility accepts Hostile, and Distance >= DistanceThreshold. An inverted Has Tags condition tests CauseTags against Id.Vehicle, ID.Item.ATMine and Id.Item.Claymore.

achievements.name: Clean Sweep
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: No event transition: Get Final Faction Scores outputs OwnScore > 0 and HighestOpposingScore == 0 for the context player faction.

achievements.name: Ricochet Kill
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.RicochetVitalityChanged: InstigatorPlayerState equals the context PlayerState, ActionTag equals KillScore, hostility accepts Hostile, and ContextTags has Meta.Progression.Context.Player.KillContext.Ricochet.

achievements.name: Defibrillator Kill
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.DefibrillatorVitalityChanged: InstigatorPlayerState equals the context PlayerState, ActionTag equals KillScore, hostility accepts Hostile, and Has Tags tests CauseTags against Id.Item.Defibrillator.

achievements.name: He's behind you
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.HesBehindYouVitalityChanged: InstigatorPlayerState equals the context PlayerState, ActionTag equals KillScore, hostility accepts Hostile, ContextTags has Meta.Progression.Context.Player.KillContext.Backblast, and the context pawn has State.Location.Objective.ControlZone.

achievements.name: Car Jacker
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.CarJackerResourceChanged: PlayerState equals the context PlayerState, ActionTag matches Challenges.Rewards.DeploySupplyCrate, and Has Tags tests ContextTags against Challenges.Context.SupplyPallet.Stolen.

achievements.name: Slot Machine
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.SlotMachineHotZoneActivated: Instigator equals the context pawn, NumCodeDigitsGuessed >= 3 and NumCodeDigits >= 4. The last binding is NumCodeDigits, despite the node label referring to drill towers.

achievements.name: Sound The Horn
achievements.criteria: Saved StateTree configuration: On Event.StateTree.SoundTheHornInteraction: Interactor equals the context pawn, InteractionMessageType equals integer 2, and Interactable passes the B_ShootingRange_Lever_PlayAudio_C class condition. Completion of B_WaitForSoundDuration_C (Sound = SFX_Prop_ShootingRange_Horn) leads to unlock; task/native behavior is unverified.

actions.name: Get {Count} Kills
rules: Enemy players only
Not a player an enemy revived
Repeats on the same player don't count

actions.name: Deliver {Count} people to the Control Zone
actions.description: Get this amount of players delivered to the Control Zone
rules: Drop off in or within 100m of the Control Zone
Spawn vehicles don't count
Counts once your passenger survives the drop-off

actions.name: Revive {Count} Teammates
rules: Teammates only
Not a player downed by a teammate or by themselves
Repeats on the same player don't count

actions.name: Destroy {Count} Occupied Vehicles
actions.description: Destroy this many vehicles that have an enemy occupant.
rules: An enemy must be driving it
An enemy must have bought it

actions.name: Activate {Count} Drill Towers
actions.description: Call the Hot Zone to a drill tower this many times by entering its code.
rules: You must enter the code yourself

actions.name: Hack {Count} Enemy FOBs
rules: You must complete the hack yourself

actions.name: Get a Freefall Kill
actions.description: Bail out of a helicopter you're piloting and kill an enemy while in freefall.
rules: Bail out of a helicopter you're piloting
Kill an enemy player while in freefall
Kills caused by destroying a helicopter don't count

actions.name: Destroy an Enemy Helicopter in Freefall
actions.description: Bail out of a helicopter you're piloting and destroy an enemy helicopter with an RPG or MAAWS while in freefall.
rules: Bail out of a helicopter you're piloting
Destroy an enemy helicopter with an RPG or MAAWS while in freefall
The enemy helicopter must be piloted and in the air

actions.name: Destroy an Enemy Helicopter in Freefall, Then Recover
actions.description: Bail out of a helicopter you're piloting, destroy an enemy helicopter with an RPG or MAAWS while in freefall, then get back into the pilot seat of your helicopter while it's still in the air, without landing or opening a parachute.
rules: Bail out of a helicopter you're piloting
Destroy an enemy helicopter with an RPG or MAAWS while in freefall
Then get back into the pilot seat of your helicopter while it's still in the air
Don't land or open your parachute first

actions.name: Destroy {Count} Enemy Spawn Radars
actions.description: Destroy the radar on this many enemy spawn vehicles.
rules: You must destroy the radar yourself

actions.name: Deliver {Count} Supply Pallets
actions.description: Drop this many supply pallets at a friendly FOB and get them fully unloaded.
rules: You must drop the pallet off your vehicle yourself
Counts when the pallet is fully unloaded, by you or a teammate
